prompt: You have a $\$25$ budget and each game credit costs $\$4$. Using $4c \le 25$, what is the greatest number of whole credits $c$ you can buy? Give just the number.

hints.text: $c \le 6.25$. You cannot buy a quarter of a credit — round DOWN to a whole number.
The greatest whole number of credits is $6$.

explanation: Credits come in whole numbers, so take the biggest whole number that fits: 6.

alternativeExplanations.title: Spend it out loud
steps: Count by 4s until you would pass 25: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 — that is 6 credits for $\$24$.
A 7th credit needs $\$28$, which is more than $\$25$. Stop at 6.
